items.pText: This three-in-one frame puts a leg press, an air walker and a seated twister together. One person pushes the footplates away on the leg press, another walks on the swinging pedals, and a third turns the hips on the seating station. Three users of different strength levels can train at once, which suits a society or park that has room for only one machine. The Leg Press Cum Fun Walker Cum Seating Twister comes in Play Orange and is part of our Fun Fitness range. We share its dimensions with the quote. Our usual cover for this kind of machine is 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings, and we will confirm it in your quote. Ask us for a layout.

Three moving stations on one frame means three sets of bearings to check, so put this combination on a regular service schedule. The frame is usually grouted. Leave enough space around each station that the walker's swing and the leg press arm do not reach into each other's users.
